info.title: FRAME Broadcast Activity Dashboard
info.description: Provider-independent structured activity publishing. For AI agents, use a registered producer bearer token and Producer-tagged operations: getCapabilities, getCurrentSession, getSessionContext, validateChanges, submitChanges and producerHeartbeat. Discover current grants before submitting viewer-facing text. All protected mutations enforce server-side scopes and revisions. Cookie-authenticated operator writes require X-CSRF-Token from /admin/me or login. No LLM, microphone, camera, OBS-control, URL fetching or arbitrary execution.

servers.description: Resolve against the dashboard origin serving /openapi.json; override with the dashboard computer address when importing a local file.

post.description: Creates no session changes, locks, proposal, receipt or publication. Actual submission repeats all checks. An existing matching successful receipt may be returned as replay. Read capabilities, current session and scoped context first. Replace example IDs, baseRevision and timestamps with current values; generate a fresh UUID for a new logical update. Prefer intent=propose for review; apply requires publishing grants. A lost submission response requires replaying the identical request ID and body.

get.summary: Download an editorial session record as JSON or Markdown
get.description: Operator-only attachment of the current stored content, including held edits. Not a publication history or database backup. Excludes retracted items, expired notices, proposals, provenance, ownership, credentials, locks, receipts and audit data. English Markdown headings preserve the original content wording as escaped literal text. GET is read-only and needs no CSRF token.

Content-Disposition.description: Attachment filename contains only session ID, captured revision and extension.
